question: Which of the following air pollutants is known as soot?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Particulate matter**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Particulate matter** is commonly known as soot.
 
• Particulate matter consists of tiny particles or droplets in the air that can be harmful when inhaled.
 
• Sources of particulate matter include vehicle emissions, industrial processes, and natural sources like wildfires and volcanic eruptions.
